units.source_text: 髭黑大将舍不得放玉鬘入宫。

en.t: General Higekuro could not bear to let Tamakazura enter the palace.

units.source_text: 然而他有个打算：乘此机会，把她从宫中直接迎归自己邸内。

en.t: Yet he had a plan: to use this opportunity to bring her directly from the palace back to his own residence.

units.source_text: 便允许她暂去即回。

en.t: So he allowed her to go for a short while and return at once.

units.source_text: 他不惯于偷偷摸摸地出入六条院，常常觉得痛苦，

en.t: He was not used to slipping secretly in and out of Rokujo-in, and often found it painful,

units.source_text: 总想早日将玉鬘接回家去，便动工修葺邸宅。

en.t: so, always wishing to bring Tamakazura home as soon as possible, he began renovating his residence.

units.source_text: 年来邸内荒芜日久，所有设备大都破旧，

en.t: For years the house had long been neglected, and most of its furnishings and fittings had grown old and worn,

units.source_text: 现在一概重新置办。

en.t: so now everything was being newly prepared.

units.source_text: 正夫人为了他的薄情而悲伤，但他全不关心。

en.t: His principal wife grieved over his coldheartedness, but he paid her no attention at all.

units.source_text: 本来疼爱的子女，现在也全不在他眼中了。

en.t: Even the children he had once cherished no longer seemed to matter to him.

units.source_text: 若是略有几分温柔情怀的人，则不论所做何事，

en.t: If a person had even a little tenderness of feeling, then no matter what he did,

units.source_text: 必能体谅旁人的心，勿使他们受到委屈。

en.t: he would surely consider other people's hearts and avoid causing them distress.

units.source_text: 可是这位大将本性直率，划一不二，

en.t: But this general was by nature blunt and single-minded,

units.source_text: 行事突飞猛进，不顾一切。

en.t: and in everything he did he rushed ahead recklessly, heedless of all else.

units.source_text: 因此旁人为他受苦甚多。

en.t: As a result, those around him suffered greatly because of him.

units.source_text: 他的正妻人品并不逊于他人。

en.t: His principal wife's character was in no way inferior to anyone else's.

units.source_text: 讲到出身，父亲是高贵的亲王，对这女儿爱护无微不至。

en.t: As for her birth, her father was a noble prince, and he cared for this daughter with the utmost devotion.

units.source_text: 世人对她十分尊敬。

en.t: People in the world held her in great respect.

units.source_text: 相貌也生得端正美丽。

en.t: Her features, too, were naturally graceful and beautiful.

units.source_text: 只是有一个异常顽固的鬼魂附缠着她，

en.t: Only an extraordinarily stubborn spirit clung to her and possessed her,

units.source_text: 因此近年来态度与常人不同，往往失却本性，形似疯狂。

en.t: and because of this, in recent years her behavior had differed from ordinary people's, and she often lost her true nature and seemed almost mad.

units.source_text: 因此夫妇之间的感情也久已疏远。

en.t: For that reason, the affection between husband and wife had long since grown distant.

units.source_text: 然而髭黑大将还是尊重她，视之为高贵无比的正夫人。

en.t: Even so, General Higekuro still respected her and regarded her as an incomparably noble principal wife.

units.source_text: 直到最近遇见了玉鬘，才意外地变了心。

en.t: Only after he recently met Tamakazura did his heart unexpectedly change.

units.source_text: 他觉得玉鬘与众不同，容貌之美远胜他人。

en.t: He felt that Tamakazura was unlike anyone else, and that the beauty of her appearance far surpassed others.

units.source_text: 尤其是世人猜疑她与源氏太政大臣有染，

en.t: In particular, people had suspected that she was involved with Genji, the Grand Minister,

units.source_text: 终于证明了她是清白之身，因此更加珍爱她。

en.t: but when it was finally proven that she was innocent, he treasured her all the more.

units.source_text: 这也是理之当然。

en.t: That, too, was only natural.
